title: As someone who never got to see Legally Blonde life, this was a dream...
transcript: To be called mine. Oh, my god, you guys. Courtney, take a break. What you want is me. What you need? On each of every heartbeat makes a pulse in my head. Big, dirty book. Big, wordy book. I love you. It's clear I'm here. It's right in front of you. In front of you. Love. I'm doing this for love. And love sees me.
